{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABYuj96Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhCTo20", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 41, "title": "Keep AI model setup unobtrusive and remove AI-resident meta labels from the PC-VAN experience", "body": "## Problem

The new first-visit AI onboarding (#39) is discoverable but overexplains the simulation. The ordinary terminal-adjacent UI currently says things like `AI住人を有効にする`, `10人の常連たちの会話を続けられます`, `10人の住人：モデル準備済み`, and `AI住人は未設定`. The consent dialog says `AI住人のモデルを準備`. Ordinary forum reading also prints `[架空の投稿時刻]` for generated posts and may expose technical `fictional-ai:<personaId>` IDs. Repeatedly explaining that the regulars are AI characters undercuts the desired feeling of entering a period-style PC-VAN and encountering people through their writing.

**The user wants to know when an AI model must be loaded, not to be constantly reminded that the people in the forums are AI simulations.** This is a presentation/wording change, **not** a request to hide how the product works, impersonate historical users, remove inspectable attribution, or bypass model-download consent.

## Expected outcome

Make the normal experience *terminal first, unobtrusive technology second*:

- A compact, neutral setup invitation near the terminal, e.g. `AIモデルの準備` / `ローカルAI機能を利用するにはモデルの読み込みが必要です。` with buttons `モデルを読み込む` and `あとで`. It does **not** announce ten AI residents or describe who is posting.
- A neutral explicit model-download consent dialog, e.g. `AIモデルを読み込む`, that still plainly discloses model sources, approximate download/storage/GPU cost, local inference and that AI generates simulated forum content. Detailed disclosures can be in an expandable explanation / Settings About, not repeated in every prompt.
- Neutral loading, success, failure, retry, paused and offline states: `AIモデルを読み込み中…`, `モデル準備完了`, `読み込み失敗`, `AIモデルの準備`; concise state updates should disappear or shrink when no action is needed rather than keeping a persistent “ten residents” advertisement.
- MAIN, SIG navigation, post lists and individual messages should look like ordinary PC-VAN content. Do not insert modern explanatory labels such as `[架空の投稿時刻]`, `架空の AI`, `AI住人`, `シミュレーション` or internal origin/actor IDs in normal terminal output. A reader should get period-appropriate displayed author handles/names or nontechnical IDs and timestamps, not raw `fictional-ai:` record keys.
- Full and honest provenance (locally generated vs prewritten fiction vs human posts), the fact that there are ten artificial residents and no actual multiuser network, and both actual generation/commit times and simulated display times remain **easy to find deliberately** in Settings → About/technical post inspection and JSON backup. Never remove source metadata or misrepresent fictional archived content as verified history.

## Context

Inspect latest `main` when implementing; known points:

- `src/ai/setup.ts` creates the terminal-adjacent `.ai-setup` notice and `.ai-consent` dialog. The accessible aside label, status text, CTA and confirmation heading repeatedly say `AI住人` / `10人の住人`. **Keep its current setup workflow, explicit consent gate, deferral, cancel, focus and recovery mechanics.**
- `src/ai/controls.ts` contains `ローカル AI 設定・投稿の出自`, `架空の AI 人格`, `10人の住人の自動活動`, `架空の活動を無効にする` and a persona-select option suffix `架空の AI`. Rename ordinary settings sections/actions to concise functional terms such as `AIモデル`, `動作設定`, `投稿設定`, `詳細・出自` without hiding the editable ten individual profiles or provenance. Prefer keeping technical inspection in a deliberately expanded subsection.
- `src/forums.ts` `renderPost` emits `[架空の投稿時刻]` for posts with `simulation`, and uses `post.authorId` in the normal `★タイトル` line. Ensure generated/seeded posts render **friendly period-style author identifiers** (e.g. existing handle) rather than technical `fictional-ai:` IDs; do not change stored identity keys, author attribution, reply integrity or export formats.
- `src/settings.ts` already has on-demand `このシステムについて / 出典・制約`. `src/storage/controls.ts` and the AI details can keep full explanations/provenance in opt-in inspection screens, rather than the regular UI.
- `data/pcvan/fictional-community.json`, `src/ai/personas.ts`, `src/storage/schema.ts`, `src/ai/activity.ts` and repository-backed posts/backup have established fiction/provenance metadata. **Preserve it unchanged.** The existing 30 seed posts, user replies and 10-resident scheduling must continue functioning.
- The app is a **browser-local PC-VAN simulator**, not a real multiuser service. Avoid misleading active-user counters, implied remote connections, invented real-person history, or covert AI: the disclosure should be accessible and accurate without dominating the period-style UI.
- Contribution workflow: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/AGENTS.md), [Issue template](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md), [development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md). Issue/PR/documentation authored in English, in-app strings in Japanese.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] First-visit notice, its accessible labels, primary button, secondary action and consent dialog consistently use **neutral AI model/setup wording**, not “activate the ten AI residents” or pitches about the characters. Initial setup remains conspicuous enough to discover without hunting through Settings, but compact and non-blocking.
- [ ] Existing affirmative download/storage/WebGPU/network consent remains explicit and truthful; cancel/“あとで”/Escape do not import, authorize or download a model. Changing to an unapproved model still requires fresh consent. Never conflate model readiness with scheduled posts.
- [ ] All regular model setup/loading/progress/ready/error/paused/retry/unavailable states use brief technical labels and only stay visible at the level needed for action or status. Do not repeatedly announce the number/nature of residents in the terminal-adjacent surface. Preserve screen-reader status updates and responsive UI.
- [ ] Settings headings and ordinary controls use concise neutral operational names while still allowing all ten profiles and scheduling settings to be edited and offering an intentionally discoverable **Details / provenance** section identifying AI-authored posts and the model used. No need to erase candid labels from the explicitly opened technical/provenance section.
- [ ] MAIN navigation, forum listing, `READ` output and displayed post headers have **no intrusive fictional-generation tags or raw `fictional-ai:` technical IDs**. Display correct author handle or a clearly defined friendly identifier for AI, seed and human content, using a safe fallback for missing/old/demo identities. Distinguish human/seed/generated posts in detailed inspection and backups. Keep timestamps meaningful, with fictional `simulatedAt` vs actual `createdAt` both retained; do not rewrite dates or persist a false origin.
- [ ] Do not alter seeded posts, identities, historical fixtures, forum routes, write/reply flows, AI scheduling, IndexedDB schema or JSON export semantics as a side effect of copy/renderer changes. Rendering works after profile renames, backups/restores and with unexpected missing authors without leaking markup or technical metadata.
- [ ] Preserve the local-only/full-simulation disclosure, model and download sources, artificial authorship and model data handling clearly under Settings → About and/or expanded technical details. No wording should imply authentic historical users or a remote PC-VAN service.
- [ ] Add/update UI, controller/renderer and accessibility tests for first-visit, consent and deferral, loaded/paused/error states, normal forum output, human/seed/generated/legacy authors, provenance inspection and reload/restore. Assert the specified intrusive labels are absent from normal views but **still visible in intentionally expanded disclosures**. Run `npm test` and appropriate build/checks; document actual results.

## Optional validation

Manual reading pass with the terminal at desktop/mobile sizes: does it feel like entering a 1996–97-era PC-VAN rather than a modern AI character showcase? This subjective review is optional, not a gate for completion.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. The normal and inspection-mode strings, consent boundary and rendering can all be tested against a local production build before merge.
